About the Clinic

Care that heals, and relieves your pain

At Suvagiya Dental and Skin Care Clinic, we provide all kinds of dental treatment under aseptic conditions, following strict sterilization protocols. All maxillofacial emergencies are attended at our clinic, along with minor oral surgical procedures — and our skin care services complete your care under the same roof.

  • ✓ Team-based dental care led personally by Dr. Ronak Suvagiya
  • ✓ Dental and dermatology care in a single visit location
  • ✓ Appointments easily booked on call or WhatsApp
Dr. Ronak R. Suvagiya

Dental Surgeon — Founder, Suvagiya Dental and Skin Care Clinic, Varachha Main Road, Surat. Practising with one simple belief: we are always there to heal and relieve your pain.

Our Services

Everything your smile & skin need

Dental Services

Complete family dentistry — from routine check-ups to advanced treatment.

Root Canal Treatment

Painless single-visit and multi-visit RCT to save your natural tooth and end tooth pain for good.

Teeth Cleaning & Polishing

Scaling and polishing that removes plaque, tartar and stains for a fresh, healthy smile.

Dental Implants

Permanent, natural-feeling replacements for missing teeth that restore full chewing and confidence.

Crowns, Bridges & Dentures

Strong, natural-looking restorations that repair damaged teeth and replace missing ones.

Fillings & Extractions

Tooth-coloured fillings for cavities, and gentle extractions — including wisdom teeth — when needed.

Minor Oral Surgery & Emergencies

Minor maxillofacial surgical procedures, with dental emergencies attended promptly at the clinic.

Braces & Aligners

Orthodontic treatment to straighten teeth and correct your bite at any age.

Kids Dentistry

Friendly, fear-free dental care designed specially for children.

Teeth Whitening & Smile Design

Brighter teeth and a smile designed around your face — for weddings, photos and everyday confidence.

Skin Care Services

Doctor-led skin care — diagnosis first, treatment that suits your skin.

Skin Consultation & Diagnosis

A proper examination of your skin concern before any treatment is suggested.

Acne & Pimple Care

Medical treatment for active acne, marks and scars — not just temporary cover-ups.

Pigmentation & Tan Care

Targeted care for dark spots, melasma, tanning and uneven skin tone.

Skin Glow & Rejuvenation

Treatments that restore freshness, hydration and a natural, healthy glow.

Medical Facials & Clean-ups

Clinic-grade facials and clean-ups matched to your skin type and concern.

Anti-ageing Care

Care plans for fine lines, dullness and early signs of ageing.
